summary: A Yes vote enacts an additional 1% transactions and use (sales) tax within the City of Ceres, with the revenue going to the city's general fund.

tax.text: A Yes vote approves the tax increase described in Measure P.
tax.quote: Vice Mayor Martinez also said citizens should have a right to decide if they want to help their city in exchange for a tax increase.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the tax increase described in Measure P.
